description: Unit tests for the google_breakpad::Module class, testing serialization, file management, function and stack frame handling, and symbol export logic.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Represents a code module with functions, source files, stack frames, and external symbols, capable of serialization.

classes.name: Module::Function
classes.description: Represents a function within a module, including address, size, parameter size, and source lines.

classes.name: Module::File
classes.description: Represents a source file associated with a module.

classes.name: Module::Line
classes.description: Represents a source line within a file, with address and line number.

classes.name: Module::StackFrameEntry
classes.description: Represents a stack frame entry with address, size, initial rules, and rule changes.

classes.name: Module::Extern
classes.description: Represents an external symbol with address and name.

methods.name: generate_duplicate_function
methods.description: Creates a new Function object with a specified name and preset address, size, and parameter size.
